newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber to senior manager Dade Cty, Fla., deal.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber to senior manager Dade Cty, Fla., deal.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc was chosen senior manager Monday for the inaugural debt issue by Florida's Dade County Expressway Authority, an $85 million revenue bond issue tentatively set for Nov 15.

The county commission's Finance and Trust Funds Committee endorsed the underwriter selection on Monday. Raymond James & Associates Inc and Howard Gary & Co will be co-senior managers for the negotiated deal.
Filling out the syndicate are co-managers Prudential Securities Inc, Smith Barney Inc, First Southwest Co, William R. Hough & Co, Douglas James Securities Inc and Grigsby Brandford & Co Inc.
The county's selection committee chose the firms from among 19 that answered its request for proposals.

The expressway authority was authorized by the Florida Legislature in 1994 and created the following spring to take over the operation of four state toll roads and two county toll roads in Dade County.
The November debt issue will finance the purchase of the state-owned roads, with debt service repaid from toll revenues.

The authority plans to issue up to $500 million of revenue bonds over the next 20 years for a variety of projects, including construction of a six-lane highway linking Miami International Airport with two other highways.

In other action Monday, Dade's finance committee voted unanimously to award Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc a contract to perform its arbitrage rebate calculations. The one-year contract has four annnual renewal options. Fees will vary according to the size and type of issue but will start at $1,000 per issue.
The underwriter selection and the Rauscher contract still must be approved by the full commission but neither is considered controversial.
